thread:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Release canary-2026-03-01 scheduled for canary rollout in eu-west-1 at 20:00 UTC. Status: HOLD — incident INC-642 (auth-service 5xx spike).

ashley.h: Copy. Can we confirm whether any canaries already started?

matt.k: nope, queue didn't drain — deploybot held preflight. I saw the same 5xx alert.

ops-oncall: we're investigating. Root cause looks like a config propagation to the auth cluster (region routing). Rolling back that config now.

ashley.h: OK, two asks: 1) pin the release so nothing accidentally drifts; 2) schedule a new rollout window once incident cleared.

deploybot: To pin the rollout run: `/deploy pin --release=canary-2026-03-01 --target-version=2026.02.28-stable --reason="INC-642 hold"`

ashley.h: I'll run the pin command in a sec (will paste confirmation).

sarah.qa: also want to hold on any automated post-deploy smoke tests until we validate auth is healthy.

leo-eng: agree. If we unpin and retry while auth is flaky we'll create noisy failure churn. Recommend postponing until metrics are green for 30m.

pm-jorge: from PM side — let's avoid a full rollback across regions unless necessary. Pinning to stable and rescheduling is fine. Need to update release notes and customer comms owners.

ashley.h: pinned. Confirmation: `deploybot: RELEASE PINNED - canary-2026-03-01 -> 2026.02.28-stable (user: ashley.h)`. RH-4532 created to track pin & retry.

deploybot: Noted. Queue state: rollout cancelled for eu-west-1 canary. No partial canaries ran.

ops-oncall: rollback of config finished at 20:03 UTC. auth 5xxs down to baseline, but ingress error rates still show small blips.

matt.k: can we get a quick canary healthcheck run (manual) once ops gives the all-clear? If it passes we can look at scheduling a limited retry in the next change window.

ops-oncall: will monitor for 30m, then run targeted test harness. I'll post results here.

pm-jorge: proposed new window: 2026-03-02 21:00 UTC (24h buffer) — gives SRE time to verify and QA time to run checks. Thoughts?

leo-eng: +1. Prefer a 24h buffer for post-incident cooldown.

ashley.h: +1. I'll update the release calendar and the release notes draft to mark the canary as postponed (reason: INC-642). Assigning notification to pm-jorge.

pm-jorge: assigned. I'll also prepare a short customer-facing blurb in case any downstream partners ask.

sarah.qa: once ops says green, I'll run the smoke suite in staging and then request a manual canary kick-off. No auto-retry.

incident-bot: INC-642 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update in 30m.

ops-oncall: monitoring windows passed initial 30m — metrics stable, running targeted smoke now (auth throughput + token validation).

matt.k: thanks. Once QA signs off, plan: manual canary (10% traffic) in eu-west-1, hold for 45m, if no regressions ramp to 50% then global. All manual steps recorded in RH-4532.

leo-eng: add explicit kernel/kv-cache flags to the canary run so we exercise the common path: `--enable-kv-cache --kernel=opt-v2`

ashley.h: noted. I'll include flags in the retry runbook.

deploybot: ACTION LOG: 1) Release pinned by ashley.h. 2) Queue cleared. 3) Tentative retry window set to 2026-03-02 21:00 UTC. 4) RH-4532 created to track.

pm-jorge: I'll follow up with customer comms and update the release notes.

ashley.h: thanks everyone. Closing thread for now — re-open when QA + ops give go. :thumbsup:

matt.k: thx — leaving a placeholder in the calendar and will wait for RH-4532 updates.

incident-bot: INC-642 final note: monitoring continues. If any regressions appear, channel will be re-alerted.
